note_en: 既然 A，就 B means "since A (is the case), then B": 既然决定要考，就要全力以赴 "since you've decided to take the exam, you have to give it everything." Unlike 因为…所以…, which explains a cause, 既然 takes a known fact as a starting point and 就 introduces the conclusion you should draw from it, much like English "now that..." or "seeing as...".
